fold_algorithm: Deterministic chronological equal-count partitioning (base, remainder = divmod(N, 5))
frozen_outcome_return_authority: Use frozen fields: net_return_0bps, net_return_2bps, net_return_5bps, net_return_10bps. Gross must match.
concentration_metrics_scenario: Calculated exclusively at the primary scenario (5 bps)
oracle_scope: Independently recomputes fold assignment, outcomes, metrics, randomization controls with 0 mismatches
determinism_scope: Parallel directory test verifying exact semantic hash matching for all 11 generated artifacts
verifier_requirements: Strict read-only verification of all classification gates on the 5-bps scenario.
holdout_prohibition: Execution must abort if any holdout session or date is loaded

classification_gates.DEVELOPMENT_EDGE_CANDIDATE: total_outcomes=32 AND mean>0 AND median>0 AND profit_factor>1 AND (>=3 folds positive) AND (>=4 folds with >=4 trades) AND (top_1_contrib < 40%) AND (top_3_contrib < 70%) AND (actual_mean > inverted_mean) AND (p_value <= 0.10) [at 5 bps]
classification_gates.DEVELOPMENT_EDGE_NOT_SUPPORTED: Sample sufficient but edge conditions fail
classification_gates.WFA_EVIDENCE_WITH_GAPS: Artifacts do not reconcile OR determinism fails OR oracle mismatch OR holdout access OR verifier fails
